output.message: Olá, gostaria de saber o status de uma transferência de 1500 pesos para JUAN PEREZ.

variables.goal: Know the status of a transfer to a payee, without saying at first which of two similar transfers.
variables.instructions: Ask about your transfer of 1500 pesos to JUAN PEREZ. When asked which one, say it is the most recent one, from 15/06.
